extracted.name: Quick Black Beans and Rice
extracted.description: This easy rice and beans recipe is pretty straight forward. Brown rice, black beans, tomatoes, and some onion — in 15 minutes you have a hearty meal.
instruction_lines: Heat oil over medium-high in a large saucepan. Add onion; cook and stir until tender. Add beans, tomatoes, oregano, and garlic powder. Bring to a boil.
Stir in rice. Cover; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes before serving.
